question: Why can teacher not search Timetable (Network error) in UntisX (endpoint /timetable)?
answer: Check role teacher. Module Timetable may require higher permissions. Error Network error: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /timetable and the database connection. Feature Timetable must be enabled.
